text:
maria: Heads up — seeing a surge of Pending pods in eu-west1 after the AZ B network flap. Lots of pods stuck with Scheduler message: "0/120 nodes are available: 120 node(s) had incompatible GPU shapes" :eyes:
kevin: ugh. is this the tiny vs large GPU packing mismatch? which GPU types are in the pool?
maria: yeah looks like a mix. a bunch of nodes drained into the same rack so pods that request 'gpu:1' are trying to fit onto A100-only nodes and failing because we enforce shapeAffinity strict.
ashley: can you paste the `kubectl describe` for one pending pod?
maria: pasted below
```
Name:         training-job-5d9c
Namespace:    ml-train
Status:       Pending
Reason:       Unschedulable
Message:      0/120 nodes are available: 80 node(s) had incompatible GPU shapes, 40 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate
```
jordan: I also see warmpool nodes are A10G-heavy, but newly provisioned capacity during the AZ glitch came back as A100s in the same AZ. mix got worse.
kevin: two levers: (1) relax shapeAffinity from strict->preferred for 15m to allow mixed packing, (2) temporarily allow `tolerate-hetero` taint on the pods so they can land on A100s. both have cost/latency tradeoffs.
maria: can we do (1) quickly? I can push a canary scheduler-config change to eu-west1 and monitor pending count.
ashley: :thumbsup: but we should alert customers using GPU billing tags — mixing shapes might increase tail latency. I'll draft a quick status note if we flip it.
kevin: I'll queue the scheduler roll (canary) with this patch:
```yaml
# scheduler config override
policy:
  shapeAffinity:
    mode: preferred
    timeout: 15m
```
We revert automatically after 30m if PodPending rate doesn't drop.
maria: doing a dry-run now. also increasing warm-pool buffer by one node per AZ to reduce coldstarts while the roll is active. aware that costs spike ~+4% for the hour.
jordan: observed that many pods still fail because of taints left over from the drain. we should run `kubectl taint nodes --all node.kubernetes.io/hetero-avoid-` in the affected AZ after confirming livework.
ashley: don't blast-taint — do it for the nodes with label `az=eu-west1b` only and add a short TTL. I'll coordinate with support for customer impact message.
kevin: canary flip done at 1799993350. monitoring metrics: scheduler.unschedulable.count dropping from 420 -> 80 in 4m.
autoscale-bot: [autoscaler] scale up event: new nodes provisioning 4 -> 6 in eu-west1b (reason: pending pods).
maria: pending down to 30 now. most of the remaining are hitting taints. I'll do targeted taint lift for eu-west1b nodes that passed health checks.
jordan: FYI we'll need a follow-up to improve our placement heuristic: detect AZ-level GPU shape skew and avoid strict shapeAffinity enforcement when skew > 30%. filed GH issue #inv/placement-328.
ashley: action items: maria — targeted taint lift + rollback plan; kevin — open PR to add a placement fallback (preferred mode) and telemetry; jordan — add cluster-level probe for shape-skew alert; I'll draft customer note.
maria: on it. will post updates here when done. :white_check_mark:
kevin: good catch. leaving the canary on for 30m then we'll evaluate with the perf team.
maria: final note — cost hit small but transient. recommend we track warm pool composition in Optimize so we can suggest warmpool flavors per workload.
ashley: agreed — file under Optimize suggestions after incident.
